facts.business: Hannah Joseph Hospital Limited operates in the healthcare services sector with a strong focus on advanced Neurosciences and Trauma Care, operating a 150-bedded hospital facility in Madurai, Tamil Nadu.

capacity_or_capex.timeline: Planned expansion, subject to timely implementation

key_risks: Clinical and operational risks associated with complex medical procedures
Increasing competition from established healthcare providers
Rising costs of medical equipment, technology, and manpower
Patient safety and quality of care risks
Pressure to reduce costs while meeting universal healthcare expectations
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions with Dr. Moses Joseph Arunkumar (Managing Director) include: 1) Professional medicine services - Rs.72.17 lakhs for FY 2025-26; 2) Lease rent for land at Chinthamani and K.K. Nagar, Madurai - Rs.161.13 lakhs (including GST) for FY 2025-26; 3) Unsecured loan taken from him (amount not specified). All transactions at arm's length basis, approved by Board on 29/05/2026.
